one_line: Meta's platform for businesses to message customers at scale via the Cloud API (Graph API endpoints).
auth_notes: Built on Meta Graph API. Requires a Meta developer account, app, business portfolio, and WhatsApp Business Account (WABA). Uses OAuth-style access tokens; permissions scoped by the app. Test account + test phone number auto-created on setup.
self_serve_notes: Self-serve via Meta developer account; free test resources (test WABA/number) with relaxed limits and no payment method. Production messaging requires business verification + per-message pricing (conversation-based).

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Cloud API (messaging/calls/groups), Business Management API (numbers, templates, analytics), Marketing Messages API
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks are core: incoming messages, message status updates, template status all delivered via webhooks

existing_mcp.note: No official Meta MCP for WhatsApp Cloud API; community MCP servers exist.

evidence.note: Rich fetched text (12.6KB) covering Cloud API, Business Management API, webhooks, test resources, rate limits

agent_notes: Fastest path is the auto-created test WABA; production needs verification and app review.
